subject: AtlasHealth: request for Dedicated GPU type + burst capacity exception
messages:

Date: 2026-02-13T10:22:00-08:00
Subject: Dedicated capacity request — A100s + burst for pilot

Hi Marissa / Sean,

Thanks again for the product walkthrough yesterday. We are moving our POC to a short pilot and need to lock in dedicated capacity. Two asks from my infra and procurement teams:

1) GPU type: we require A100-80GB for model fidelity — initial reservation of 4 GPUs.
2) Burst: ability to burst up to 8 GPUs for up to 72 hours/month over the reservation for traffic spikes.
3) Overage/discount: Procurement is asking for a capped overage rate for burst hours and a 20% customer-first discount on base price during the 6-month pilot.

Can Redwood support non-standard terms here (reservation hold while our legal completes PO, capped overage rate, and a temporary discount)? We have a signed PO draft — attaching.

Attachment: AtlasHealth_po_0417.pdf (pdf)

Next steps: please advise what approvals you need and an estimated cost for the proposed config. We need to present to our finance on Monday.

Best,
Jordan

Date: 2026-02-14T09:18:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Dedicated capacity request — A100s + burst for pilot (requesting exec approval)

Marissa / team — I reviewed Jordan's ask. This is a mid-size POC but strategic (healthcare partner) so we should consider an exception. Proposed commercial terms to present for exec sign-off:

- Reservation: 4 x A100-80GB dedicated for pilot (6 months).
- Burst: Allow up to 8 GPUs for up to 72 hours/month. We cap billed burst hours to actual usage but propose a capped overage rate of $14.00 / GPU-hour during pilot.
- Discount: 15% off list for the pilot period (instead of the 20% requested). Customer can convert to a 12-month commit after pilot with standard long-term discounts.
- Reservation hold: place a 30-day soft-hold on capacity for AtlasHealth while legal finishes PO; hold requires signed LOI and initial deposit (one month of reservation fees).

Why: 15% keeps margin while signaling flexibility; capped $14/hr overage limits their upside while compensating for burst interference risk.

Need sign-off from Markus for the reservation hold and pricing exception. Lauren — can you confirm revenue ops can route an invoice with deposit + hold? Vivek — are there infra constraints for allowing burst up to 8 GPUs for a single tenant?

Rishi
VP, Sales — Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-15T14:42:00-08:00
Subject: Re: RE: Dedicated capacity request — A100s + burst for pilot (capacity feasibility)

Rishi / team — technical notes on feasibility and risk:

- A100-80GB is supported and will meet AtlasHealth's model needs. We can schedule 4x A100s in a dedicated pool.
- Burst to 8 GPUs is feasible but must be gated with quota and throttles. We recommend:
  * Burst cap: 8 GPUs per tenant
  * Burst window: 72 hours/month aggregated (not contiguous)
  * Preemption policy: allow soft preemption for non-critical background workloads to ensure SLOs for other commitments.

Operational impact and uplift:
- To guarantee burst availability we must reserve spare capacity regionally during peak windows; estimate an uplift of ~18% on top of the base reservation cost to cover opportunity cost and buffer (this is why capped overage should be above base).
- We will instrument tracing and token-level cost attribution to ensure we can bill exact burst hours.

If finance wants a lower overage rate we can accept $12.50/hr but only with a longer deposit or a 12-month commit after pilot. Otherwise $14/hr is more defensible.

—Vivek
Head of Serving Infrastructure, Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-02-18T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Approval: AtlasHealth Dedicated capacity exception (conditional)

Team / Jordan — after reviewing, I approve the exception on the following conditional terms:

1) Commercial
- Reservation: 4 x A100-80GB for 6 months.
- Burst: Up to 8 GPUs, up to 72 hrs/month. Billed at a capped overage rate of $13.50 / GPU-hr for the pilot.
- Pilot discount: 15% off list for the pilot months.
- Reservation hold: 30-day soft hold secured by an initial deposit equal to one month of reservation fees. If PO is not finalized within 30 days, hold will be released.

2) Operational guardrails (Vivek to implement)
- Burst will be gated by quota with preemption policies and tracing enabled.
- Detailed burst reporting will be provided weekly during pilot.

3) Legal / finance
- Require executed PO and signed addendum documenting capped overage, reservation hold, and invoice schedule.
- Tessa / Lauren to coordinate invoice terms; require SOC2 evidence snapshot and standard DPA.

Jordan — please confirm acceptance of these conditions and return the signed addendum so we can put the hold in place. Marissa — take point on collecting the LOI + deposit. Lauren / Tessa — please prepare the addendum and proforma invoice. Vivek — baseline the uplift and confirm the instrumentation timeline.

Markus Klein
Chief Revenue Officer, Redwood Inference
